summary: Wrote a five-phase implementation plan executing the research report's recommendations: an advisory, mode-aware cycle_budget_advisory field computed at admission time in orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh from the plan file's own phase headings against the shared batch cycle pool, threaded additively onto both dispatch-row construction sites. Phases are compute+stderr, row threading with a consumer audit, eight fixtures (including the byte-identical non-interference diff, the 11-phase originating shape, and the phase-10-of-11 real-history counter-case), documentation in both named homes, and a redeploy plus full gate set with an explicit source-store TARGET. Four planning judgment calls the research left open are recorded as Decisions: both threshold operands come from the plan file rather than the handoff; an inconclusive heading scan suppresses rather than blocks; the stderr line re-emits per cycle rather than deduplicating; and only implement-phase candidates are considered. Strict-mode validate-artifact.sh passes with zero warnings.

artifacts.summary: Five-phase plan for the advisory plan-size versus per-run cycle-budget notice.
